name: Quick and Easy Queso Dip
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 10 oz (280 g) stewed tomatoes with green chiles
0.5 lb (225 g) monterey jack cheese, grated

steps: In small pan, heat undrained tomatoes and onion, cooking until the juice is gone.
While tomatoes are cooking, place Velveeta in microwave-safe bowl and melt in microwave. Add monterrey jack cheese and melt mixture using 50% power.
Add tomato mixture to cheese mixture.
